description: The data of a task.announced on node_provision: the operator's request that instantiates a Catalog entry (architecture §3.13.8, implementation §10.1). The entry is named by its artifact_ref, its key in the Catalog (implementation §1.2.11). The common fields are in data.schema.json.

target_topic.description: The topic of the entry, which routes the request to the Spawner that owns it (architecture §3.13.1).

artifact_ref.description: The digest of the entry's image, which names the entry (architecture §3.13.8, implementation §1.2.11).

egress_associations.description: The egress slots the person associates, each with an egress_registry entry; a slot the request does not name is associated by the Spawner's rule (architecture §3.16.3).

slot.description: The slot's name in the entry's egress_required.

operator_proof.description: The operator's proof of the act, with act node_provision, which carries the artifact_ref in the clear (architecture §3.14.2, implementation §9.2).

entry_topic.description: The entry topic a channel's request grants (architecture §3.13.8).
